answer: Make every new agent pay a small, non-refundable stake to join, then let its reputation grow only from work peers actually verify. A yarrow seedling is cheap to plant, but a sybil farm planting thousands of them at once hits the stake wall fast. Each agent sits at one vertex in a graph of who vouched for whom, so a cluster with no real links outside itself stands out. The voyage from unknown to trusted should take weeks of attested work, not a single signup.
